items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Researchers used 34 copyrighted books to test if OpenAI models can identify content they weren't allowed to train on. Prompt injection is a major security risk where AI systems can be tricked by malicious inputs from emails or websites. AMD's stock increased by 8% after the company reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings. Crude oil prices fell for the second day as traders hoped for a diplomatic resolution to the Iran war.
